name: 2022 World Championships Deck: The Shape of Mew

releases.name: 2022 World Championships Deck: The Shape of Mew

description.text:
One of the top eight decks of the Masters Division at the 2022 World Championships, beaten by the eventual champion. It is built for Mew VMAX's Cross Fusion Strike: Genesect V's Fusion Strike System draws cards, and four each of Quick Ball, Battle VIP Pass and Cram-o-matic search the deck for the Pokémon that fill the Bench. The 2022 World Championships were held at ExCeL London from 18 to 21 August 2022, the first in Europe and the first since 2019, after the COVID-19 pandemic put off the 2020 and 2021 events.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2022 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
